title: Vidhā (I--IV)
text: [2--33] Tisso imā bhikkhave vidhā || katamā tisso || || Seyyo ham asmīti vidhā || Sadiso ham asmīti vidhā || Hīno ham asmīti vidhā || || Imā kho bhikkhave tisso vidhā || || Imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave tissannaṃ vidhānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo || || katamo ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmim || || Imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave tissannaṃ vidhānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || || Yathā esanā evam vitthāretabbā || ||
